chain.title: What The Squid Leaves Behind
chain.desc: Squid drop tentacles through data/oceansdelight/loot_modifiers/cut_tentacles_squid.json. Vanilla squid give ink and nothing else; now they give dinner.

chain.title: Portioned On The Board
chain.desc: Knife tentacles on a cutting board. Cut tentacles are the base of the fried recipes.

chain.title: Skewered
chain.desc: A tentacle and a stick. The simplest thing this mod makes and the fastest food on a boat.

chain.title: Greens From The Seabed
chain.desc: Seagrass and a bowl. The only recipe here that needs no mob at all.

chain.title: Filled And Tied
chain.desc: A cod stuffed with onion, tomato, kelp and mushroom, bound with Farmer's Delight rope. The rope is what makes this a Farmer's Delight recipe rather than a vanilla one.

chain.title: Cutting A Pufferfish Carefully
chain.desc: Knife a pufferfish on a cutting board with bone meal alongside. Done properly it stops being poison.

chain.title: The Guardian, Whole
chain.desc: Guardians drop themselves as an ingredient through guardian_drop.json. Ocean monuments become a fishing ground.

chain.title: Taking The Tail
chain.desc: Knife a guardian on a cutting board with bone meal. The tail is the cut worth cooking.

chain.title: Tail Over Fire
chain.desc: Campfire, furnace or smoker. Proof you cleared enough of a monument to farm it.

chain.title: The Elder, Butchered
chain.desc: Elder Guardians drop a slab of themselves through cut_elder_guardian.json. There are only three per monument, which makes this the mod's rarest ingredient.

chain.title: Sliced Down
chain.desc: Knife the slab with bone meal. Each elder yields a handful of slices and no more.

chain.title: Seared
chain.desc: The slice cooked. The single most valuable piece of food in the ocean.

chain.title: The Monument, Rolled
chain.desc: Elder guardian slices with Farmer's Delight cooked rice. This mod's endgame dish.

notes: All 22 ids resolve as assets/oceansdelight/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys - zero models_only and zero lang_only. Small mod, so ONE wheel rather than three, said plainly. Three loot modifiers supply every animal ingredient: cut_tentacles_squid.json (squid -> tentacles), guardian_drop.json (guardian -> a whole guardian item) and cut_elder_guardian.json (elder guardian -> slab). The chain's gating is the ocean monument itself: everything up to stuffed_cod is craftable from open water, everything from oceansdelight:guardian onward requires you to fight into a monument, and the elder guardian line is capped at three kills per structure. A quirk worth recording for a quest generator: the cutting recipes for guardian_tail, elder_guardian_slice and fugu_slice all list minecraft:bone_meal as a second input beside forge:tools/knives. Most recipes are wrapped in forge:conditional, but scanning the conditions shows no forge:mod_loaded gate on any of them beyond farmersdelight itself, so nothing here needs a third mod. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:cooked_rice, farmersdelight:rope, farmersdelight:tomato, onion and cabbage crops, any forge:tools/knives knife.
